description: This file defines the AttributeDatasource class, which manages attribute data fetching, selection, and WebSocket subscriptions for telemetry attributes in an Angular application. It interacts with services to retrieve attribute data, handles subscriptions for client-side telemetry, and provides observable streams for UI components.

classes.name: AttributeDatasource
classes.description: Manages attribute data retrieval, selection, and WebSocket subscriptions for telemetry attributes in an Angular app.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Returns an observable of the attribute data array for UI binding.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Completes subjects and unsubscribes from telemetry subscriptions.

methods.name: loadAttributes
methods.description: Loads attribute data for a specific entity and scope, with optional reload.

methods.name: fetchAttributes
methods.description: Fetches attribute data with filtering based on last update timestamp.

methods.name: getAllAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves all attributes, either from WebSocket subscription or HTTP service, with caching.

methods.name: isAllSelected
methods.description: Returns an observable indicating if all attributes are selected.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Returns an observable indicating if attribute list is empty.

methods.name: total
methods.description: Returns an observable of total attribute count.

methods.name: masterToggle
methods.description: Selects or clears all attribute items.
